visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoor scene: A red gas cylinder has a large flame shooting out from its top valve. A man wearing a brown tactical uniform and a red beret quickly approaches from the right and throws a thick, damp brown cloth over the flames to extinguish them. A crowd of uniformed students stands in the background watching. (2) Indoor scene: A woman with long black hair, wearing a black tank top, sits at a wooden desk in a hotel room. She is gesturing wildly with her hands and speaking with an expressive, angry facial expression. A bedside lamp glows warmly behind her. (3) A man's arm enters the frame from the left and drops a large white towel directly onto the woman's head, completely covering her face and torso. She immediately stops moving and remains slumped in place while the man's hand pats the top of her head. (4) The camera begins a handheld tour of a large hotel suite, showing a purple carpeted living area with two beige sofas, a white standing lamp, and a wall-mounted television. (5) The camera moves into a bedroom area with two twin beds with white linens and a long white makeup vanity with a mirror on the wall. (6) The camera enters a luxurious bathroom, showing a dual-sink vanity, a glass shower stall, a white bidet toilet, and a large heart-shaped whirlpool bathtub. The person filming is visible in the mirrors wearing blue jeans. (7) The camera operator pulls back a white curtain from a window inside the bathroom that looks directly into the main living quarters of the suite.
